question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who feeds on human flesh
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cannibal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cannibal"** refers to a person who feeds on human flesh. (आदमखोर)

 
 
• **Example:** The island was rumored to be inhabited by cannibals who preyed on shipwrecked sailors.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct one-word substitute for "a person who feeds on human flesh" is **'Cannibal'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Cannibal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Carnivore** (मांसाहारी): An animal that feeds on flesh.

 
 
• **Example:** The tiger, a carnivore, stalked its prey silently through the jungle.
 
 
 
• **Nudge** (कोहनी से हलका धक्का): A gentle push or prod.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave him a nudge to get his attention during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Omnivore** (सर्वाहारी): An animal or person that eats both plants and animals.
 
 
• **Example:** Bears are omnivores, feeding on both plants and animals.
